reference_sql:
SELECT category_name, SUM(units) AS units_sold, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY category_name
HAVING SUM(units) > 40000 AND SUM(net_revenue_eur) < 2000000
alternatives: SELECT category_name, SUM(units) AS units_sold, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY category_name HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) < 2000000 AND SUM(units) > 40000
SELECT category_name, SUM(units) AS units_sold, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(units) >= 40001 AND NOT SUM(net_revenue_eur) >= 2000000
